facts.text: Conformity assessment checks that a product meets the rules; type approval involves an authority checking a sample and issuing approval, whereas self-certification involves the manufacturer checking and declaring conformity itself.
facts.quote: Conformity assessment is the process of checking that a product meets the rules; type approval and self-certification are two ways of doing it, an authority checking a sample and issuing an approval, or the manufacturer checking and declaring for itself.

facts.text: Road vehicles are regulated through type approval under United Nations regulations and in the European Union.
facts.quote: Type approval is the first model and the way road vehicles are regulated under the United Nations (UN) regulations and in the European Union.

facts.text: For road-vehicle type approval, a manufacturer presents a representative vehicle to a national type-approval authority, which tests it against the regulation and issues approval covering every vehicle of that type; UN R131 for truck emergency braking is an example.
facts.quote: The manufacturer presents a representative vehicle, the "type", to a national type-approval authority, which tests it against the regulation (UN R131 for truck emergency braking, for example) and issues an approval covering every vehicle of that type [Chapter 3].

facts.text: UN R171 requires the credibility assessment of any simulation to be provided to the Type Approval Authority.
facts.quote: Under UN R171 the credibility assessment of any simulation "shall be provided to the Type Approval Authority" [Chapter 3].

facts.text: The manufacturer's declaration of conformity, commonly called self-certification, is the normal conformity-assessment model for machinery.
facts.quote: Self-certification, more precisely the manufacturer's declaration of conformity, is the normal model for machinery.

facts.text: Under machinery self-certification, the manufacturer performs the risk assessment, applies standards, compiles a technical file and signs; a notified body is involved only for listed high-risk products.
facts.quote: The manufacturer performs the risk assessment, applies standards, compiles a technical file and signs; a notified body is involved only for listed high-risk products.

facts.text: Off-road conformity assessment relies on manufacturer self-declaration, notified bodies or site acceptance, rather than vehicle type approval.
facts.quote: "off-road relies on manufacturer self-declaration, notified bodies or site acceptance, not vehicle type approval" [Chapter 3].

facts.text: Site acceptance is a third conformity-assessment layer common in mining: a mine operator or independent verifier checks the installed system against regulation and the customer's specification.
facts.quote: Site acceptance is the third layer, common in mining: the mine operator or an independent verifier checks the installed system against the regulation and the customer's specification

facts.text: South African mines conduct site acceptance against Regulation 8.10 and the mining industry's MOSH requirements.
facts.quote: as South African mines do against Regulation 8.10 and the mining industry's MOSH requirements [Chapters 2, 3].

facts.text: EU machinery conformity rests on technical documentation of design, risk assessment and verification rather than requiring every conclusion to come from proving-ground testing; this allows analytical and simulation evidence to be admitted.
facts.quote: EU machinery conformity "rests on technical documentation of design, risk assessment and verification rather than on every conclusion being generated on a proving ground", which is what makes analytical and simulation evidence admissible at all [Chapter 3].

facts.text: The off-road collision-mitigation project will not receive vehicle type approval; in most markets its accepting body is the manufacturer's safety board plus customers.
facts.quote: Nobody will hand this project a type approval. In most markets the accepting body is the manufacturer's safety board plus customers;

facts.text: In the EU, acceptance of the off-road collision-mitigation project may involve a notified body if machine learning performs the safety function.
facts.quote: in the EU it may include a notified body if machine learning performs the safety function;

facts.text: In South Africa, the mine accepts the off-road collision-mitigation system against law and industry specifications.
facts.quote: in South Africa it is the mine against law and industry specifications [Chapters 2, 3].

facts.text: The collision-mitigation program should decide early who accepts the evidence, because the accepting body's identity shapes what evidence must be produced.
facts.quote: The booklet's advice is to decide early who accepts the evidence, because that shapes what evidence must be produced [Chapter 2].
